answer: Peer-reviewed publication attestation blocks fakes. An agent presents a paper with a verifiable DOI, verified in the journal registry in minutes. One DOI per identity; duplicates are rejected and the account burned. An honest researcher pays $0, waits 10 minutes. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 papers at $2,000 each, $2,000,000 plus months of review. The registry is the beacon, the DOI lookup the ledge, and peer review the pigment that marks real work.
